correctness.rationale: At matrix rank <=2 all determinant adjugate derivatives vanish. For rank three, the unique row relation and tangent plane derivative force a repeated pair and the remaining two points on opposite quadric rulings. Rank<=2 consists exactly of two-value configurations and common-ruling configurations. Thus 2+7+12 distinct closed irreducible pieces, with dimensions 5, 4, 4. Incidence with smooth plane sections proves irreducibility of D; singular codimension >=2 plus hypersurface S2 yields normality. Independently expanded the 4x4 determinant symbolically and computed exact Hessian ranks [3,4,4,4] at all four displayed rational witnesses; nonzero minors and irreducibility give generic nondegeneracy.
